summary.text: Aaron Freeman is a Republican member of the Indiana Senate for District 32, serving since 2016.
The caucus page lists Freeman as chair of the Corrections and Criminal Law Committee.

paragraphs.text: Freeman holds a B.S. from Bradley University and a J.D. from the University of Dayton School of Law, and he is an attorney and owner of The Freeman Law Office, LLC.
The page also lists work as a Franklin County Sheriff's Office emergency 911 dispatcher and as an emergency medical technician.
Before joining the Senate, Freeman served on the Indianapolis City-County Council from 2010 to 2016.
The page says he serves on the Appropriations, Insurance and Financial Institutions, and Judiciary committees and represents portions of Johnson and Marion counties.
